name: Karnak (Advanced)
parking_info: Park on gravel road near industrial buildings on dry side of levees. Walk over to water and put in. A Sutter County option for something between Knights Landing and the Confluence.
walk_to_water: Walk over levees to water and down to waterline. Steep with rip rap rocks, slippery.
cautions: Slippery, rocks line take out. Water is calm there, though. Property access is ambiguus, water district staff leave me alone when they see I am just boating.
